reason: A media hosting and playback plugin that serves local image, video, and audio files and integrates previews and playback controls into the WebUI.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地图片、视频和音频托管，并在 WebUI 中集成预览、播放与状态查看功能。
summaries.en: Provides local image, video, and audio hosting for DSH with integrated preview, playback, and status controls in the WebUI.

capabilities: Starts and stops a local Python static file server
Serves local image, video, and audio files over HTTP with range requests
Registers a local /files/ route mapped to configured filesystem directories
Adds WebUI media playback, image preview, and status controls
